verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Rollbar serves an llms.txt at docs.rollbar.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured docs summary, so an agent can be pointed straight at it. Many doc pages are also served as raw .md endpoints, and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec is linked from the docs, giving agents machine-readable material. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or agent-oriented docs offering, any evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content variant, and independent corroboration of how well agents use these docs.
